    About Dai

    Dai is a decentralized, crypto-collateralized stablecoin soft-pegged to the US dollar, originally issued by MakerDAO and now part of the Sky ecosystem alongside USDS.

    Where this DAI price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Kraken (DAI/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 5.37B DAI (supply last updated November 2, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
